map.升力 L = ½ × ρ × V² × S × C_L，其中 ρ 为空气密度（海: Lift L = ½ × ρ × V² × S × C_L, where ρ is air density (about 1.225 kg/m³ at sea level), V the airspeed (m/s), S the wing reference area (m²) and C_L the lift coefficient; dynamic pressure q = ½ρV², so L = q × S × C_L; in cruise lift equals weight (L = m × g), from which the required airspeed V = √(2mg ÷ (ρSC_L)).
map.低速近似不可压。: Low-speed approximation treats the flow as incompressible.
map.C_L 随迎角变化。: C_L varies with angle of attack.
map.由空气密度、空速、机翼面积与升力系数算机翼升力 L=½ρV²·C_L·S。: Compute the wing lift L=½ρV²·C_L·S from air density, airspeed, wing area and lift coefficient.
map.配平计算：升力≈重量时飞机平飞，用于性能与载荷分析。: Trim calculation: the aircraft flies level when lift is about equal to weight, used for performance and load analysis.
map.对比不同飞行阶段（起飞增升、巡航、着陆）的升力需求。: Compare the lift required at different flight phases (takeoff high-lift, cruise, landing).
map.着陆密度 ρ≈1.225、空速 V=70 m/s、面积 S=30 m²、放下襟翼: Landing density ρ≈1.225, airspeed V=70 m/s, area S=30 m² and flaps down C_L=1.8. L=½×1.225×70²×1.8×30 = ½×1.225×4900×1.8×30 ≈ 162 kN. High-lift devices help maintain enough lift at low speed for a safe landing.
map.本质是因翼型上下表面气流速度差（伯努利+环量）产生压力差。升力系数 C_L 把攻: Essentially from the pressure difference caused by the airspeed difference between the upper and lower surfaces of the airfoil (Bernoulli + circulation). The lift coefficient C_L combines the angle of attack, flaps and shape into a single non-dimensional quantity, convenient for calculation with a unified equation.
map.升力和载重怎么配平？: How are lift and weight trimmed?
map.稳定平飞要求升力=重力。载重增加需更大 C_L 或速度，受失速与结构限制；超过包: Steady level flight requires lift = weight. Increasing the load needs a larger C_L or speed, limited by stall and structure; beyond the envelope you must reduce load or adjust the CG.
